pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
You turned your back like you were ending it all
Our clashing words, a heart that hasn’t cooled at all
A voice inside my chest that never got to sound
I’m standing still inside the echo now
Your unread names still linger in my mind
My sincerity got lost, then circled back in time
Because it was love, even the anger too
You let it drift away into the silent blue

[Verse 2]
Why do we always pass each other by
No excuse, no apology can reach in time
Because it’s love, it makes my eyes ache too
Please, let it reach you
This is love, it’s true
Because it was you, my emotions shook
Hate and longing collide like a raging flood
I’m left behind like a half-written line
If I erase you, I’m afraid I might collapse inside

[Bridge]
The last remaining scent of broken love
The more I hold on, the more it fades to dust
At the end, a confession standing alone
Still… you’re the only one I know

[Final Chorus]
Just once would be enough, just one moment in time
That even wounds and sorrow were another name for love
Let’s face each other again
With a truth deeper than silence
So we don’t lose each other’s hearts
With an echo that never ends
Let’s love again
Please… let’s start again
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
